events.title: Musk
events.blurb: MUSK is an incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world’s most heralded “inventor-entrepreneur” who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live. A Bleecker Street release

events.title: A Talent for Murder
events.blurb: The smoldering chamber thriller, A TALENT FOR MURDER, from Anton Corbijn (Control) stars Academy Award winner Helen Mirren and Alden Ehrenreich (Weapons) as opponents in a strange confrontation between a youthful literary agent and “The Talented Mr. Ripley” author Patricia Highsmith. A Bleecker Street release

events.title: Dao
events.blurb: French Senegalese filmmaker Alain Gomis’s ecstatic epic, DAO, plunges headfirst into two separate yet intrinsically interconnected ceremonies: a memorial in Guinea-Bissau and a wedding in Paris, which Gomis cuts between with kinetic abandonment. A Janus Films release

events.title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
events.blurb: Genre-defying director William Greaves searches for the divine origins of his own creativity at a cocktail party he masterminded in 1972 for the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance. Directed by David Greaves, William’s son, ONCE UPON A TIME IN HARLEM celebrates the creative geniuses who came together to relate during a rapidly shifting cultural landscape. A NEON release

events.title: A Bit of Light
events.blurb: After being arrested and having his medical practice shut down, A BIT OF LIGHT follows a disillusioned Iranian doctor who loses faith in the future. Determined to end his life, he spends one final day visiting his siblings and mother to prepare them for his departure. Their compassion, care, and companionship slowly reconcile him with reality.

events.title: Opening Night: In Memoriam
events.blurb: Includes ticket to Opening Night Party at Site Santa Fe

events.title: World Indigenous Shorts
events.blurb: Presented by Institute of American Indian Arts and Cherokee Film

events.title: Clarissa
events.blurb: CLARISSA reconceptualize's Virginia Woolf’s "Mrs Dalloway". Set in modern day Lagos, Nigeria, the film follows a high society wife (Sophie Okonedo) preparing for a party that will put her face to face with an old flame. She spends the evening reflecting on her youth and the choices that led her to marry a respected man instead of her poet boyfriend. Stars Sophie Okonedo, David Oyelowo, India Amarteifio, Toheeb Jimoh, Nikki Amuka-Bird, and Ayo Edebiri. A NEON release

events.title: Opening Night Party
events.blurb: Join us for our stellar Opening Night Gala at Site Santa Fe catered by Santa Fe Chef. Music by Party Girl DJs.

events.title: Barbara Forever
events.blurb: BARBARA FOREVER explores the films, archive, and ongoing cultural impact of experimental filmmaker Barbara Hammer, revealing her ingenious lifelong artistic effort to create and record lesbian histories, personal and societal, spanning four decades. The film centers Hammer as a prism of the cultural ecosystems around her and breaks taboos around female sexuality, aging, illness, and queer love. Winner of Jonathan Oppenheim Editing Award for U.S. Documentary at Sundance.

events.title: Heysel 85
events.blurb: Violence erupts before the 1985 European Cup Final between Liverpool and Juventus at Brussels’ Heysel Stadium, killing 39 people. HEYSEL 85 follows the mayor’s daughter and an Italian journalist as they are drawn into the heart of the tragedy, caught between professional duty, family loyalty, and moral responsibility.

events.title: Everytime
events.blurb: A tragedy brings a mother, daughter, and teenage boy together. Struggling with blame and forgiveness, the unlikely trio takes a trip to Tenerife for a family holiday that never happened. Under the glow of the sun, past and present quietly start to overlap in EVERYTIME. Germany's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®

events.title: All of a Sudden
events.blurb: ALL OF A SUDDEN tells the story of Marie-Lou (Virginie Efira), a director of a care facility for the elderly, who strives to introduce an innovative care philosophy based on listening and respecting residents’ dignity, despite resistance from part of her staff. Her encounter with Mari (Tao Okamoto), a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path. Japan's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®. A NEON release

events.title: Carl Sagan: We Are Made of Star Stuff
events.blurb: CARL SAGAN: WE ARE MADE OF STAR STUFF is an intimate portrait of the visionary astronomer, author, and television star whose groundbreaking ideas transformed our understanding of the cosmos and human existence. With unprecedented access to his extensive personal archive, the film explores Sagan’s cosmic love story with partner Ann Druyan and his evolution as a father, husband, and scientist. A National Geographic Documentary Films release

events.title: Look Back
events.blurb: From director Hirokazu Kore-eda(Shoplifters, SFiFF 2017) LOOK BACK follows Fujina, precocious and popular; she’s happy hanging with friends and drawing weekly strips for her grade school publication. One day she meets her match in Kyomoto, a homeschooled student with a dazzling technique. Soon, the two are close collaborators, creating manga together and enjoying great success. Everything is wonderful until one day, Kyomoto breaks the partnership. A GKIDS Films Release

events.title: The General
events.blurb: Johnnie loves his train ("The General") and Annabelle Lee. When the Civil War begins, he is turned down for service because he's more valuable as an engineer. Annabelle thinks it's because he's a coward. Union spies capture The General with Annabelle on board. Johnny must rescue both his loves in the Buster Keaton classic, THE GENERAL.

events.title: Ni-Naadamaadiz: Red Power Rising
events.blurb: Despite it lasting 28 days in 1974, there is only eight minutes of footage about an Indigenous youth-led armed occupation in Kenora, Ontario. NI-NAADAMAADIZ: RED POWER RISING follows the charismatic Louis Cameron and the Ojibwe Warriors Society, who fought for Indigenous human rights and were joined by members of the American Indian Movement, who crossed the border to join directly after Wounded Knee.

events.title: Film by Ben Proudfoot
events.blurb: Films by Ben Proudfoot

events.title: Minotaur
events.blurb: MINOTAUR takes place in Russia, 2022. When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures and an increasingly unstable world, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence. France's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®. A Mubi release

events.title: Lady
events.blurb: In LADY, A determined taxi driver in Lagos forms an unexpected bond with a group of free-spirited women, leading her into a world of friendship and self-discovery despite the risks along the way. As Lady becomes entangled in their world, the nights grow more dangerous, and the city presses harder against old wounds she’s never confronted.

events.title: threeASFOUR: FULL CIRCLE
events.blurb: Filmed over five years with breathtaking intimacy, first-time feature documentary director Sean Ono Lennon, THREEASFOUR: FULL CIRCLE has continually pushed the boundaries of what fashion can be for more than 25 years. Gabi Asfour, Angela Donhauser, and Adi Gil, the threeASFOUR collaborators, navigate the impossible tension between art and commerce, choosing art at every turn. Producer Beth Levison and Editor Jenny Golden in Attendance.

events.title: What Price Glory
events.blurb: U.S. Marine sergeants, Quirt and Flagg, are inveterate romantic rivals on peacetime assignments in China and the Philippines. In 1917, W.W.I. brings them to France, where Flagg, now a captain, takes up with flirtatious Charmaine, the innkeeper’s daughter, in WHAT PRICE GLORY.

events.title: People of the West  (Episode 1)
events.blurb: On Kumeyaay/Ipai land in 1542, PEOPLE OF THE WEST - EPISODE 1 follows a teenager’s coming-of-age ceremony that collides with the arrival of explorer Juan Rodríguez Cabrillo. The village greets the strangers in cautious diplomacy until Spain’s “Requerimiento”. A clash over fishing rights sparks violence, and two children are abducted as “interpreters,” foreshadowing centuries of dispossession.

events.title: Closure
events.blurb: After his teenage son goes missing, Daniel scours the depths of the Vistula River, torn between the dread of a fatal leap and the hope that his son may still be alive. CLOSURE transcends the true-crime cliché as this masterful study of obsession documents a father’s quest for answers in the wake of his teenage son’s disappearance. Director Michal Marczak and Executive producer James Costa in attendance.

events.title: Coffee Chat with Michael McGarrity
events.blurb: New Mexican author Michael McGarrity discusses his series of crime novels, as well as writing, craft, and creativity, focusing on the author’s voice. Moderated by Mary-Charlotte Domandi.

events.title: Burn, Scar
events.blurb: BURN, SCAR delves into the aftermath of the prescribed burn set by the U.S. Forest Service in the mountains of northern New Mexico in 2022 that would escape its firelines and spiral out of control to become the largest wildfire in the state’s history. The film captures families devastated by the fire, Forest Service crews struggling to move forward, and climate adaptation. Director Hillary Bachelder in attendance.

events.title: Gentle Monster
events.blurb: GENTLE MONSTER follows Lucy(Léa Seydoux), a concert pianist, who has just relocated her family to a country house in the hope of easing her husband’s severe burnout. Before they can settle in, an early morning police visit tears their world apart. Lucy must face the situation alone, trapped between the man she loves and the fear of what he may have done. A Netflix release

events.title: Variety's 10 Screenwriters to Watch
events.blurb:
Variety's annual 10 Screenwriters to Watch list recognizes the honorees at this year’s Santa Fe International Film Festival. This year marks Variety’s third year in partnership with SFIFF to present its annual Screenwriters to Watch list.

As Variety continues to celebrate up-and-coming scribes, the 10 selected will be spotlighted in a panel conversation at the festival Oct. 15, moderated by Variety's senior entertainment writer Angelique Jackson.

events.title: Fjord
events.blurb: Winner of the Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival, FJORD tells the story of the Gheorghius (Sebastian Stan and Renate Reinsve), a devout Romanian Norwegian couple who resettle in a village set in a distant fjord where they befriend their new neighbours, the Halbergs. When Elia Gheorghiu shows up at school with some bruises on her body, the community thinks the Gheorghius’ traditional and questionable education approach might have something to do with it. Romania's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®. A NEON Release

events.title: The Liberation
events.blurb: Rita (Carrie Coon), a woman in midlife haunted by the weight of her past, encounters magnetic young spiritual leader Ricki (Lily James) and leaves her family to follow her to an all-female commune. When her daughters Ella (Bella Ramsey) and Jo (Odessa Young) arrive unexpectedly, Rita is forced to choose between the family she left behind and the life she believes can save her. A Bleecker Street release

events.title: #UnderTheInfluence
events.blurb: In #UNDERTHEINFLUENCE, Brooke Haven (Cassidy Freeman) and Chelsea Haven (Alexandra Renzo), the daughters of the first mommy blogger, agree to star in a reality TV show based on their childhood fame as the daughters of the first real mommy blogger. They quickly learn reality is negotiable, relationships are for sale, and sisterhood is the only thing that can save them.

events.title: Coffy
events.blurb: COFFY is a one-woman vigilante force, out to even the score with those who have hooked her sister on drugs. Using both her wiles and deadly weaponry, Coffy sets about ridding the streets of drug dealers, pimps, and deviants.

events.title: Bedford Park
events.blurb: When her mother’s car accident brings her back to her parents’ home, Audrey (Moon Choi) meets Eli (Son Sukku), the man responsible for the accident. Writer-director Stephanie Ahn’s feature debut, BEDFORD PARK, explores the complexities of diasporic experience through a chance encounter between two thirtysomething, second-generation Korean Americans, tracking their relationship as it moves from circumstantial to friendly to romantic. A Sony Pictures Classics release

events.title: Campeón Gabacho (Gringo Champion)
events.blurb: A determined Mexican migrant boxes his way through challenges and discrimination in America, using his fighting spirit and optimism to rise above adversity and find unexpected success in Campeón Gabacho (Gringo Champion).

events.title: Rehearsals for a Revolution
events.blurb: Pegah Ahangarani sketches her life story of resistance through five portraits of relatives and mentors in REHEARSALS FOR A REVOLUTION. Drawing from personal archives, home videos, street protest footage, newspapers, and recorded voices, she retraces more than 40 years of Iran’s history, piecing together a portrait of a country shaped by political repression and in constant hope for a revolution. A Sony Pictures Classics release

events.title: Reservation Redemption
events.blurb: RESERVATION REDEMPTION tells the powerful story of Chief Marchand Rice, a man who journeyed from a life sentence for murder to becoming a voice of hope, healing, and transformation. Raised on the Yakama Reservation, Chief’s early life was marked by struggle, loss, and a cycle of self-destruction, leading to his incarceration. Co-directors Brenda Fisher and Blake Pickens in attendance.

events.title: Faust
events.blurb: FAUST follows a pious alchemist, despairing as plague rages through the village. His prayers unanswered, he turns from God and summons the demon Mephisto, who grants him healing powers for one day. When the gift backfires, Faust hies back to his garret, where Mephisto waits with even sweeter enticements.

events.title: 14th
events.blurb: Written in the wreckage of the Civil War, the 14th Amendment was meant to close the door on the hierarchy of human worth. Instead, it has become the subject of a permanent argument. Ava DuVernay’s 14TH pulls this constitutional fight out of the footnotes and into the present, chronicling the vicious battle over the amendment that has raged for over 150 years. A Netflix Release

events.title: Who Likes Short Shorts (Short Filmmaker Panel)
events.blurb: Short filmmakers discuss their films in the 2026 Santa Fe International Film Festival.

events.title: Fork in the Road
events.blurb: FORK IN THE ROAD follows small farmers, visionary chefs, and innovators working to heal the land, improve our food systems, and transition toward a regenerative future for both people and the planet. The inspiring documentary travels from Alaska’s kelp farms to Kentucky dairies and Bronx urban gardens, spotlighting the farmers and food innovators reshaping our broken food system. Co-director Vivian Sorenson in attendance.

events.title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
events.blurb: In THE ONLY LIVING PICKPOCKET IN NEW YORK, Harry Lehman (John Turturro) is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family. A Sony Pictures Classics release

events.title: La Bola Negra
events.blurb: At the cusp of the Spanish Civil War, LA BOLA NEGRA follows a young man who confronts his ideology and sexuality as he is conscripted into the fascist army, where he becomes fascinated by a prisoner of war. Another young man in pre-dictatorship Spain finds himself blackballed from his father’s prestigious social club due to rumours about his sexuality. Starring Guitarricadelafuente, Miguel Bernardeau, Carlos González,Milo Quifes, with special appearances by Penélope Cruz and Glenn Close. Spain's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®. A Netflix release

events.title: Foxy Brown
events.blurb: After her brother betrays her, FOXY BROWN follows a woman who goes undercover as a prostitute in order to find the gangsters who killed her boyfriend, and get revenge.

events.title: Fatherland
events.blurb: At the height of the Cold War, writer Thomas Mann and his daughter, actress, writer, and rally driver Erika (Sandra Huller), embark on a road trip in a black Buick cruiser across a divided Germany in ruins, traveling from the Allied-occupied city of Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar in FATHERLAND. Poland's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®. A Mubi release

events.title: You made a film, what's next? (Panel)
events.blurb: Industry insiders discuss the next steps on how to market and edit a film with Kate McQuerrey(Buff, No Country for Old Men, Burn After Reading), Christina Campagnola (Circle Collective), Kyle Greenberg (Utopia), Sandrine Cassidy (USC)

events.title: Coffee Chat with Howard Korder
events.blurb: Pulitzer Prize-winning screenwriter and playwright Howard Korder is also an American television producer. He won two Primetime Emmy Awards and served as a writer and executive producer on Boardwalk Empire. Moderated by William DeBuys.

events.title: Blood Lines
events.blurb: BLOOD LINES is a lesbian romance wrapped up in a celebration of Métis culture and centers around an upcoming Métis Day festival. Storyteller and store clerk Beatrice (Dana Solomon) is completely taken by a new woman who arrives in her Métis community looking to find her biological family. Beatrice decides to help Chani (Derica Lyn Lafrance) in order to spend more time with her. Director Gail Maurice in attendance.

events.title: Possible Love
events.blurb: For Ho-seok and Mi-ok hope to move on from the trauma caused by the disastrous outcome of a labour dispute in POSSIBLE LOVE. When they are approached by a young, ambitious documentary filmmaker Ye-ji to take part in her latest project, they become intimately intertwined with her and her business-mogul husband, Sang-woo. South Korea's submission to the 2027 Academy Award®. A Netflix release

events.title: Centrepiece: I Play Rocky
events.blurb:
I PLAY ROCKY is an electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn’t just meant to write Rocky; he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds. The result is the ultimate underdog story behind the ultimate underdog movie. An Amazon MGM release

Introduction by Editor Sam Seig

events.title: Give Me The Ball!
events.blurb: We remember Billie Jean King’s infamous impact on tennis and gender equality, but in GIVE ME THE BALL!, we come to understand the sacrifices she was forced to make behind the scenes. Through rarely seen archival material and powerfully honest interviews with King, her story of selflessness, struggle, and triumph shines an unforgettable light on the groundbreaker. Co-director Elizabeth Wolff in attendance.

events.title: Tender Loving Care
events.blurb: As the demands of work and family begin to converge, a social worker(Kate O’Flynn) and those closest to her discover the strength found in compassion, community, and one another. Set in post-Brexit England, the final film by Mike Leigh, TENDER LOVING CARE is a richly observed portrait of resilience, humor, and the enduring power of human connection. A Bleecker Street release

events.title: Only What We Carry
events.blurb: Long-buried secrets and emerging romances bubble up and boil over between a dancer, her sister, her former choreographer, and his visiting friend in ONLY WHAT WE CARRY, an improvisational drama shot in six days on the Normandy coast. Starring Simon Pegg, Charlotte Gainsbourg, Quentin Tarantino, Liam Hellmann, and Lizzy McAlpine.

events.title: Visionary Award Zahn McClarnon
events.blurb:
The Santa Fe International Film Festival will present its Visionary Award to distinguished actor Zahn McClarnon. Followed by a discussion with Chris Eyre executive producer of DARK WINDS. Following the dicussion, SFiFF will screen McClarnon's directoral debut Dark Winds season 4, episode 2, Bikéé' Doo Éédahooziideegóó. (Toward Their Unknown Paths)

McClarnon is most recently known for his leading role as Lieutenant Joe Leaphorn in the AMC series Dark Winds executive produced by George R.R. Martin and the late Robert Redford. DARK WINDS follows two Navajo police officers in the 1970s as they investigate numerous seemingly unrelated crimes and is set in the American Southwest and shot in Santa Fe.

events.title: Centrepiece: Wild Horse Nine
events.blurb: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris (John Malkovich) and Lee (Sam Rockwell) are dispatched from Santiago to Easter island by their bureau chief, MJ (Steve Buscemi). Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students (Mariana di Girolamo and Ailín Salas) threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways. A Searchlight Pictures Release

events.title: Elephants in the Fog
events.blurb: ELEPHANTS IN THE FOG follows a Nepalese village nestled in the heart of a forest inhabited by wild elephants. Pirati, the matriarch of a Kinnar community, dreams of escaping to live with the man she loves. But when one of her daughters goes missing, she must investigate and choose between her desire for freedom and her responsibilities to her community. Nepal's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®

events.title: Sender
events.blurb: After receiving a series of unnervingly personal packages she never ordered, a woman (Britt Lower), newly sober and starting over, spirals into paranoia, convinced someone is watching her. As the online retailer denies responsibility, her search for the anonymous sender sends her down a dangerous rabbit hole. SENDER is a tense psychological descent into surveillance, recovery, and self-doubt. Featuring Rhea Seehorn and Jamie Lee Curtis.

events.title: Radon's Daughters
events.blurb: RADON’S DAUGHTERS tells the fate of two New Mexican families that collide at a toxic Día de los Muertos celebration in a Uranium-tainted church. After her mother mysteriously vanished from the Uranium mines feeding the nearby government lab, Nita Iglesias (Morningstar Angeline) is desperate for one more reunion as Día de los Muertos approaches, drawing the dead back home. Director Siena Sofia Bergt in attendance.

events.title: Galicia!
events.blurb: GALICIA! is a found-footage documentary following Anna Maguire and Kyle Greenberg through their home videos as they visit their friends at a winery in rural Spain. What starts as a couple’s travelogue devolves into a heightened vision of the end of days, inadvertently recording the unimaginable and leading us to question the fragility of humanity and its power to endure. Co-Directors Anna Maguire and Kyle Greenberg in attenance.

events.title: Our Effed Up World
events.blurb: Sheri thought her biggest problem in life was dealing with the recent loss of her beloved grandma. But when a mysterious entity crash-lands in the woods, only she and her group of shitkicker friends are what stands in the way of an insatiable, intergalactic hunger in OUR EFFED UP WORLD.

events.title: SUMO: Spirit Weighs Nothing
events.blurb: SUMO: SPIRIT WEIGHS NOTHING grants rare inside access to Japan’s hidden world of sumo. Over a turbulent year, wrestlers at every stage of their career fight to endure, revealing that true strength is measured not in flesh, but in spirit.

events.title: Daughters of the Forest
events.blurb: DAUGHTERS OF THE FOREST takes place deep in Mexico’s forests, where two Indigenous mycologists embark on an unexpected, sometimes speculative exploration of the realities of two Indigenous communities and the fungi in the forests of Mexico, inviting them to reconsider the perceptions and experiences of both the human and non-human inhabitants of our world.

events.title: Ink
events.blurb: From Academy Award-winning director Danny Boyle INK follows the life of Rupert Murdoch(Guy Pierce) and his group of visionaries and misfits who had an idea for a new kind of news, one that would give the people what they want and would change the face of the world we live in today. A Netflix release

events.title: Major Barbara
events.blurb: Based on the Tony-nominated play by George Bernard Shaw, MAJOR BARBARA tells the story of a wildly idealistic young woman, Barbara Undershaft (Sara Haider), who helps the poor as a Salvation Army Major at an anything-goes homeless shelter. She's a stalwart devotee to the cause and has visions for the place - although her ambitions are often squashed by a lack of funding. Director Jay Craven and star Tantoo Cardinal in attendance.

events.title: La Gradiva
events.blurb: A group of French high school students travel to Naples on a school trip to discover the ruins of Pompeii and the bodies petrified by Vesuvius in LA GRADIVA. There, they are drawn into a dizzying descent. One by one, they are swept up in desire and anger until they surrender to them completely. Winner of the Grand Prize (Ami Paris Grand Prize) at the Cannes Film Festival Critics' Week.

events.title: Nuisance Bear
events.blurb: NUISANCE BEAR immerses viewers in the experience of a polar bear forced to navigate tourists, wildlife officers, and hunters as climate change delays the freeze and pushes bears closer to human settlements. When a sacred predator is branded a “nuisance,” it becomes unclear who truly belongs in this shared landscape. Winner of the Grand Jury Prize for Documentary at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival.

events.title: Smudge The Blades
events.blurb: SMUDGE THE BLADES is a coming-of-age hockey film that follows the TREATY 6 BLADES, a U18 team from a small reserve outside of Edmonton, forced to salvage their final year of hockey in the rough-and-tumble Country League of northern Alberta. Actor Jana Schmieding in attendance. Winner of the Best Canadian Discovery Award from the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival

events.title: Lifetime Achievement Award Pam Grier
events.blurb: The prestigious Lifetime Achievement Award to acclaimed actress, singer, and activist Pam Grier followed by a discussion moderated by screenwriter and SFiFF advisory board member Kirk Ellis (Franklin, John Adams). A powerhouse of talent and a pioneer for African American representation in Hollywood, Grier has captivated audiences for more than four decades. She is perhaps best known for her performances as the title character in Jack Hill’s exploitation action film, Foxy Brown (1974) where Grier’s powerful and triumphant physical presence offset subversive sex appeal, setting her apart from other women actors at the time. Nearly three decades later, she played the title character in Quentin Tarantino's Jackie Brown (1997), for which she earned a Golden Globe nomination for Best Performance by an Actress in a Motion Picture.

events.title: Roadmap Writers Screenwriting Workshop
events.blurb:
Take a look at any roadmap: There are a plethora of ways to get from point A to point B. Some routes require more luck than others; some are roads less traveled; while still others are riddled with detours... Breaking into and sustaining a career in the screenwriting business is hard – sometimes it can feel nearly impossible.

Enter Roadmap Writers, a team of industry veterans dedicated to equipping screenwriters with the real-world tools and training needed to take their career to the next level.

events.title: Iron Boy
events.blurb: IRON BOY follows 10-year-old Christophe (Gary Clichy), who tries to live up to his rigid and distant father on the family farm. Overcome by dizzy spells that disable him from doing most things, Christophe must reinvent his life away from the farm by wearing an iron corset to keep himself upright. A Sony Pictures Classics release

events.title: Timber Lands
events.blurb: In the rugged Pacific Northwest, a generations-old feud between an Indigenous family and a powerful logging dynasty reignites, pulling a new generation into a war over blood, legacy, and the land they both call home. TIMBER LANDS confronts the complexity we’re often asked to simplify. Director Baylee Toney and actor Wes Studi in attendance.

events.title: Brian
events.blurb: BRIAN follows Brian: smart, funny, and deeply depressed. A disastrous drama club audition leads to a public meltdown, thus beginning Brian’s search for his new “thing.” With help from his therapist and the new kid, Justin, Brian launches his high-stakes campaign and sparks a messy, exquisitely awkward journey toward self-acceptance.

events.title: Seized
events.blurb: Balancing the absurdity of small-town politics with the gravity of a constitutional crisis, SEIZED, set in the small town of Marion, Kansas, is thrust into the international spotlight after a police raid on the Marion County Record and the death of its 98-year-old co-owner.

events.title: Madwoman's Game
events.blurb: Executive produced by Keanu Reeves, MADWOMAN'S GAME follows the coming-of-age story of Bianca Mitchell-Avila, a young Latina chess enthusiast from Albuquerque, New Mexico. As she explores life’s lessons through the lens of the game, she must ask herself: should she stay in her hometown or start somewhere new? She suspects the game may hold the answer, setting her off on a journey across the world. Bianca Mitchell-Avila in Attendance

events.title: Coffee Chat with Catherine Hardwicke
events.blurb: Catherine Hardwicke (SFiFF 2023 Visionary Awardee) is the director of Thirteen, Lords of Dogtown, and Twilight, whose work spans award-winning indies to billion-dollar global franchises that launched the careers of a generation’s biggest stars. Catherine will speak about her newest film Street Smart (SFiFF 2026). Moderated by Alexandria Bombach.

events.title: Ceremony
events.blurb: When the Nuxalk trace their vanished ooligan through settler tapes and a land claim filed the very day smallpox arrived, their radio station becomes courtroom, confessional and conjuring ground; there, an older law insists: the fish and the people return together or not at all. CEREMONY was made for the Nuxalk community, who asked for this story to be told, and that twelve-year responsibility shaped every part of its creation. Winner of the audience award at SXSW. Director Banchi Hanuse in attendance.

events.title: Street Smart
events.blurb: A lively group of street kids in Venice Beach help each other chase their dreams in STREET SMART. When the crew finds out their camp will shut down and a new girl pressures them into bending (or breaking) their moral code, it threatens to tear apart this makeshift family. The group forges unbreakable bonds and redefines what it means to be a family. Director Catherine Hardwicke in attendance.

events.title: Closing Night: Paper Tiger
events.blurb: In James Gray’s deeply felt and intense drama PAPER TIGER, two brothers (Adam Driver and Miles Teller) become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences. A NEON Release

events.title: Closing Night Party
events.blurb: As we close out the festival explore the exquisite cocktails of As Above So Below, enjoy empanadas by Cafecito Santa Fe, dance, and say good bye to all the wonderful friends you made during the festival. 21+

events.title: Little House on the Prairie (Season 1 Episode 7): A Softer Note in the Sound of the Wind
events.blurb: In THE LITTLE HOUSE ON THE PRAIRIE (Season 1 Episode 7), the Osage convene for a crucial tribal council where the future of their land and Laura's bond with Good Eagle hang in the balance. Q&A with director Sydney Freeland and Osage Cultural Consultant Julie Okeefe.
